tools.name: list_event_types
tools.title: List user's event types
tools.description: List the event types a Calendly user or organization offers for booking, such as a 30-minute intro call. Use when you need the available meeting types or an event type URI for other tools.

active.description: True for active event types only, false for inactive only; omit for all.

admin_managed.description: True for admin-managed event types only, false to exclude them.

count.description: Number of rows to return per page (maximum 100).

organization.description: Organization URI whose event types to list. Provide user or organization.

page_token.description: Page token from a previous response's pagination.next_page_token.

sort.description: Sort field and direction, for example start_time:asc.

user.description: User URI whose event types to list. Provide user or organization.

user_availability_schedule.description: With user, only event types that use this availability schedule.

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: Get the Calendly user who owns the connected account, including their user and organization URIs. Use when you need the account owner's own URI to pass to other Calendly tools.
